optimizedContext.value:
# ImplementationDetector

## Rules
- `detectModifiedFiles(change, options?)` → project-relative candidate paths. `excludePaths?` = portable dir prefixes to exclude.
- Detector owns baseline policy; callers pass Change only. No link/resolved/ignored classification.
- Demand-driven: invoked by `RefreshImplementationTracking` only. NOT by GetStatus, TransitionChange, CompileContext, or Change entity.
- Backend-agnostic; VCS first but not required.

## Constraints
- Paths: forward-slash, project-root-relative. No workspace identity assignment. excludePaths same normalization.
